name: Neuro-Kurisu SUPER
integrity: source-first; generated app/public Live2D shadows are omitted from the source archive and hash-verified before Vite dev/build; path-level duplicates are recorded in restoration manifests; no runtime state, node_modules, caches, or generated verification state shipped
willIntegration: bounded WILL agency signal applied before P69; P69 remains sole final arbiter
latestIntegration: WorkPass70 uses one monotonic browser speech-audio clock for both published audioTimeMs and Live2D viseme sampling. Per-utterance speechEventId/audioClockId, UTF-16 charIndex boundary anchors, optional elapsedTime calibration, stale/out-of-order anchor rejection, versioned single-envelope viewer protocol and iframe-ready resend are implemented. This remains approximate boundary-based synchronization, not PCM/phoneme ground truth.
readinessNote: WorkPass70 targeted timeline tests, strict helper TypeScript check, root app script suite, runtime typecheck, viewer syntax, release metadata, runtime release contract/integrity/source verification pass. Chromium could not initialize/complete even a simple headless page in this container; actual browser/Live2D playback and p95 audio-to-mouth offset remain unverified. App dependency-complete build and physical Android TTS, provider/device recovery, memory uplift (recallDelta=0/not-promoted), rollback, license review and soak remain open.
actionApprovalGate: ActionGateway remains the single durable gate; app request layer suspends protected API calls, shows a sanitized approval card and resumes the captured exact JSON operation once only in the current tab.
approvalRecovery: After page refresh, server-persisted pending tickets without an in-tab continuation are shown as unclaimed. Only a pending ticket may be explicitly declined. The original request body is never persisted, and no side effect is replayed from an orphaned ticket.
